show.description: An epic fantasy adventure inspired by Journey to the West, where gods, demons, and mortals clash in a world of magic and destiny. Season 1 follows the unlikely band of heroes as they set out on a perilous journey, testing their courage, loyalty, and bonds while uncovering the secrets of the heavens and the underworld.
